original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚战斗加剧，政府军称重新夺回阿拉马塔
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚北部战斗加剧，亲政府武装称在与叛军多线交战后已重新控制提格雷南部战略城镇阿拉马塔。阿拉马塔位于通往提格雷的主要公路上，其失守据称标志着提格雷叛军的逆转。冲突引发对重返2020至2022年全面内战的担忧，该内战据估计造成约60万人死亡。

key_facts.fact: 亲政府武装称已重新夺回提格雷南部城镇阿拉马塔
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Pro-government forces in Ethiopia said Monday they had taken control of the town of Alamata in southern Tigray after days of clashes with rebel forces across multiple fronts.

key_facts.fact: 阿拉马塔位于通往提格雷的主要公路上，其失守据称是提格雷叛军的逆转
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The loss of Alamata, a strategic town on a major highway into Tigray, would mark a reversal for Tigrayan rebels, who launched offensives against the government on multiple fronts last week.

key_facts.fact: 冲突引发对重返2020至2022年全面内战的担忧，该内战据估计造成约60万人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The clashes have raised fears of a return to the full-blown civil war of 2020-2022 that caused the deaths of an estimated 600,000 people.

key_facts.fact: 夺回阿拉马塔的消息由与联邦政府结盟的提格雷和平力量在脸书上宣布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fall of Alamata was announced on Facebook by a Tigrayan splinter group, the Tigray Peace Force, that has aligned with the federal government.

uncertainties: 阿拉马塔被夺回的说法目前仅来自亲政府一方，尚未获得独立证实
事件为单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
伤亡人数为对2020至2022年内战的估计，非本次冲突确认数据
